root_cause: Build 1905 started module loading automatically at DOM ready and stored the result forever in loadPromise. If that first mobile/4G module load failed or timed out, loadPromise resolved false and every later Start/Search press immediately reused that failed promise. The button therefore appeared permanently dead.
fix: Removed background module preloading; the first actual Start/Search interaction owns the first load attempt.
A failed/timed-out load resets loadPromise, so the next tap really retries.
Each retry imports a fresh app.js URL with a unique boot counter, avoiding a sticky failed app module URL in the current browser document.
A 15-second bound prevents a hung module request from leaving the button waiting forever.
Search still prevents native form navigation, and the roadtrip engine is unchanged.
